result:
I'd make people feel less alone in their suffering.

Not eradicate pain — that's impossible and maybe not even desirable — but make it so when someone is hurting, they don't have to carry the sense that no one would understand if they said it out loud. 

If empathy was as reflexive as a startle response, a lot of cruelty would become unthinkable, and a lot of good would become inevitable.
